changelog:
Streams from a provider that checks the user-agent now play.

WHAT WAS FIXED

- Some providers (and the CDNs in front of them) refuse a request that
  names a raw library instead of a player, even with the right
  credentials. The television was sending exactly that, so every stream
  from such a provider failed while the phone played it fine. The
  television now introduces itself as PerchTV, the way the phone
  introduces itself as MobileIPTV.
- A channel that asks for a specific user-agent still gets it.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else. Pairing, playback, updating and the failure words
  from 0.1.2 are unchanged.
